insights.one_liner: Amsterdam social enterprise selling fresh soups and giving at least half its profit to fight loneliness among elderly people, run largely with students.

culture.text: Sells fresh soups and meals and donates at least 50% of profits to its foundation, which brings young and old together against loneliness.
Student boards in cities organise weekly Cooking Days and Soup-to-Door Days.
Founded in 2017 in Amsterdam; people come from Utrecht, Maastricht, Groningen, Tilburg and Erasmus, often studying economics, psychology or communication.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open marketing internship in Amsterdam needs no Dutch.
